{"consolidated_memory":"CORRUPTED SCAFFOLD IN cli/commands/init.py — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents share the same symptom and reproduction path:
- Component: cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling)
- Problem: corrupted scaffold in the init command
- Reproduction: init into a directory that already has a lockfile
- Signal: generated tree missing one file
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_init.py

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-25]
- Trigger: first request after a cold start
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #3835, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1
- Result: job finished in 42 minutes instead of 7 hours

INCIDENT 2: [2026-07-09]
- Trigger: only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #4358, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-2
- Result: alert stayed quiet for 73 consecutive days

INCIDENT 3: [2026-09-01]
- Trigger: only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #8929, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3
- Result: cold start dropped 82 percent, to 779 ms"}
